title: The art of an unhurried Himalayan escape
excerpt: A better way to plan mountain days: fewer hotel changes, longer silences, better memories.
content: The Himalayas don't reward hurry. The most memorable mountain trips aren't about ticking off viewpoints — they're about waking up slowly to birdsong, lingering over chai with a view, and letting the landscape set the pace. Here's how to plan a trip that actually feels like rest.

title: Bali beyond the beach club
excerpt: Three intimate corners of the island for travellers who want the story, not the crowd.
content: Skip the Instagram clichés. Bali's real magic lives in the rice terraces of Sidemen, the quiet temples of East Bali, and the artist studios of northern Ubud. Here are three corners that reward curiosity over content.

title: Why the North East belongs on your list
excerpt: A route through clouds, tea gardens, heritage, and the generous warmth of the region.
content: From the living root bridges of Meghalaya to the monastery trails of Arunachal, India's North East is a mosaic of culture, nature, and warmth. Here's why it deserves to be much more than an afterthought on your travel list.
